title: Isolated dedicated session

the session is recorded under the isolated home

the injected context is persisted in the rollout file
the session status is readable by its controlling process
a new process resumes the same session identity after the controlling process exits
the resumed session still refers to the same rollout file
the persisted context survives the restart on disk
a scoped MCP server is registered in the isolated home

the session resumes with its scoped tools still registered
